book_array_tutorial.001.decision: Replaced desktop keys in the chapter with the actual VR mapping: forward stick follows controller aim; sideways stick moves across that aim. Rolling the controller is not a sideways command. The existing museum sign retains desktop instructions.

book_array_tutorial.002.decision: Developed the changing floor, as the author requested. The blue sphere now writes once per operation into the hall’s real grid. Entry-side PAUSE / RESUME and RESTORE FLOOR controls expose those changes. Perimeter/threshold cells and the existing Molnár pad are protected. A consumed exposed cell reveals the surface one metre below; an actual museum body descends onto it. Restore waits for an occupying body. Added this encounter to final.md and the primary reading order. Headset traversal, recovery and comfort still need observation.

book_array_tutorial.003.decision: Replaced the mistaken right-hand cue with the direction-free landmark beyond ONE EXCEPTION. This is the same sentence corrected for image stretching in comment 008.

book_array_tutorial.004.decision: Distinguished the row’s overhead labels from the second line’s number plates at the cubes’ feet. The secondary column remains available for comparison.

book_array_tutorial.005.decision: Named the actual starting state and the DEPTH 1 / 4 and RESET controls. The Molnár study arrives displaced; the reader now has a concrete way to establish the ordered comparison.

book_array_tutorial.006.decision: Reordered the visit: select an address outside, fly to its cube, collect it, hover in the vacancy, then descend and return to read zero. The console inset is identified as a separate view outside the enclosure; the prose no longer implies it can be read while hovering.

book_array_tutorial.007.decision: Located the sequencer near the entrance, six metres to the right of the console as one enters. Replaced the misleading claim that it stands beside the console.

book_array_tutorial.008.decision: Named the stretch caused by the tall wall sheet: its triangles are more than twice as tall as they are wide. Preserved the chapter’s argument about the receiver changing the image; merged with the orientation repair in comment 003.

book_array_tutorial.009.decision: Recaptured all three affected figures in the working Godot museum with the desktop-only MushroomHand count hidden by the capture probes. Published clean native composites at stable book paths; preserved historical originals. The wall and disco runs passed their inherited controls/collision/capture checks.

book_array_tutorial.010.decision: Used the exact source expression step % disco_floor.grid_width. The floor is twelve columns wide here; the width belongs to the configured floor rather than a hard-coded twelve in the bridge.

book_array_tutorial.011.decision: Said that the sequencer starts with an empty pattern, then invited the first cell. The text no longer sends a visitor into the dropdown to select its existing state.

book_array_tutorial.012.decision: Changed the Molnár illustration’s alt text to describe all four layers seen at an angle, matching the oblique view.
